units.L-paths: long_search paths on a 32-200 bp window of the record: a path spells it.
units.L-verified: paths with labels and require_support record_verified: the record's path is verified.
units.L-supported: Supported paths selected by the taxid predicate, and at the label_intersection level: the record verified.
units.L-anchors: A 45 bp pattern without long_search: anchors counted, paths withheld.
units.L-caps: max_paths 0 cuts (partial) or withholds (all_or_count); max_annotation_work 10 stops or cuts the search.
units.L-memory: A 100 kb homopolymer on a self-loop with max_memory_mb 1 stops on {extension, max_memory}.
units.L-long-length: A 500-2000 bp window with paths: exactly one path spells it.
units.L-long-other: A reverse-complement window under strands reverse is the record's path as '-'; a 60 bp IUPAC pattern's paths hold the record's; A^60 with max_anchors 1 lists its two anchors and admits no extension.
units.L-repeat: A homopolymer of 60 / 100 with paths carries the low_complexity_pattern note.
